verdict.rationale: ZCode ships its own browser interface (`zcode --web`). It can listen on a LAN address with token-authenticated links, so other devices' browsers can reach a running instance, and tasks can be woken remotely via WeChat, Feishu or Telegram. Nothing documents that a task or session started on one device carries over to another device or browser. missing for 10: documented session handoff or sync across devices, cloud-backed session continuity beyond LAN access to a single host, hands-on corroboration of cross-device continuation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start a task on one device and continue it later from another device or browser

citations.quote: 提供桌面应用、浏览器界面和终端 Agent
局域网访问可使用 `--host 0.0.0.0`；监听非本机地址时默认生成访问令牌，使用终端输出的带令牌链接。
通过微信、飞书或 Telegram 远程唤起 ZCode，让任务随时进入执行状态。
